examples: The announcement caused such a tumult that the meeting had to be paused.
این اعلامیه چنان آشوب و هیاهویی ایجاد کرد که جلسه مجبور شد متوقف شود.
Amid the tumult of the crowded market, she could barely hear her friend's voice.
در میان هیاهوی بازار پرازدحام، او به‌سختی می‌توانست صدای دوستش را بشنود.
The country fell into political tumult after the sudden resignation of its president.
کشور بعد از استعفای ناگهانی رئیس‌جمهورش دچار آشوب سیاسی شد.
miniContext: Tumult describes a state of loud confusion, disorder, or commotion among a crowd of people. The stadium erupted into tumult the moment the referee made the controversial call. Historians describe the years following the revolution as a period of constant tumult and uncertainty.

examples: A swarm of bees settled in the old tree near the garden fence.
دسته‌ای از زنبورها روی درخت قدیمی نزدیک حصار باغ نشستند.
As soon as the doors opened, a swarm of shoppers rushed toward the discounted items.
به محض باز شدن درها، انبوهی از خریداران به سمت اجناس تخفیف‌دار هجوم بردند.
The lake's surface was covered by a swarm of mosquitoes at dusk.
سطح دریاچه هنگام غروب با انبوهی از پشه‌ها پوشیده شده بود.
miniContext: A swarm is a large group of insects, or by extension, a crowd of people, moving together. Beekeepers sometimes have to carefully relocate a swarm that settles too close to a house. Reporters formed a swarm around the actress the moment she stepped out of the car.

examples: The jury took three days to reach a verdict in the murder trial.
هیئت منصفه سه روز وقت صرف کرد تا به یک رأی در پرونده قتل برسد.
The defendant's family wept when the verdict of not guilty was announced.
خانواده متهم وقتی حکم بی‌گناهی اعلام شد، گریستند.
Critics are still debating the verdict, calling it too lenient for such a serious crime.
منتقدان همچنان درباره این حکم بحث می‌کنند و آن را برای چنین جرم جدی‌ای بیش از حد ملایم می‌دانند.
miniContext: A verdict is the official decision made by a jury or judge at the end of a trial. The courtroom fell silent as everyone waited to hear the verdict read aloud. Even after the final verdict, the case continued to attract public attention for years.

examples: She wrote a detailed biography of the scientist, based on his personal letters.
او زندگینامه مفصلی از آن دانشمند نوشت که بر اساس نامه‌های شخصی‌اش بود.
The library added a new biography about the explorer to its history section.
کتابخانه یک زندگینامه جدید درباره آن کاشف به بخش تاریخش اضافه کرد.
Reading his biography helped me understand why he made such unusual choices in his career.
خواندن زندگینامه او به من کمک کرد بفهمم چرا چنین انتخاب‌های غیرمعمولی در شغلش داشت.
miniContext: A biography tells the true story of a person's life, usually written by someone else. Many students are assigned to read a biography of a historical figure for their history class. Unlike an autobiography, a biography is written from an outside perspective, often after years of research.

examples: As the tide began to recede, children ran out to collect shells on the wet sand.
همان‌طور که جزر و مد شروع به عقب‌نشینی کرد، بچه‌ها بیرون رفتند تا روی شن‌های مرطوب صدف جمع کنند.
His hairline started to recede noticeably in his early thirties.
خط موی او در اوایل سی‌سالگی به‌طور قابل توجهی عقب رفت.
Economic fears tend to recede once new jobs start appearing in the market.
ترس‌های اقتصادی معمولاً وقتی شغل‌های جدید در بازار پدیدار می‌شوند، کاهش می‌یابند.
miniContext: To recede means to move back or gradually decrease, like water pulling away from the shore. Floodwaters finally began to recede three days after the storm ended. As memories of the accident recede over time, the town has slowly returned to normal.

examples: She donates part of her salary to a children's charity every month.
او هر ماه بخشی از حقوقش را به یک خیریه کودکان اهدا می‌کند.
The local charity provides free meals to families who cannot afford groceries.
خیریه محلی به خانواده‌هایی که توان خرید مواد غذایی ندارند، غذای رایگان می‌دهد.
Out of charity, the shop owner let the homeless man sleep in the doorway on cold nights.
آن مغازه‌دار از روی بخشندگی اجازه داد مرد بی‌خانمان در شب‌های سرد در ورودی مغازه بخوابد.
miniContext: Charity refers both to organizations that help people in need and to the act of giving generously. Every winter, the charity collects warm coats for families who cannot afford them. He has always shown charity toward strangers, often giving whatever he can spare.

examples: The knight had to kneel before the queen to receive his new title.
شوالیه باید در برابر ملکه زانو می‌زد تا عنوان جدیدش را دریافت کند.
Gardeners often kneel on a small mat to protect their knees while weeding.
باغبانان اغلب روی یک تشک کوچک زانو می‌زنند تا هنگام علف‌چینی از زانوهایشان محافظت کنند.
She knelt beside the injured dog and gently checked its paw.
او کنار سگ زخمی زانو زد و با آرامی پایش را بررسی کرد.
miniContext: To kneel means to lower the body so that one or both knees touch the ground. Many religious traditions ask followers to kneel during prayer as a sign of respect. During the ceremony, the new graduate had to kneel briefly while the medal was placed around her neck.

examples: He looked dejected after losing the championship match in the final minute.
او بعد از باخت مسابقه قهرمانی در دقیقه آخر، دل‌شکسته به نظر می‌رسید.
The dejected team walked off the field without saying a word to each other.
تیم دل‌شکسته بدون اینکه کلمه‌ای به هم بزنند از زمین بیرون رفت.
She felt dejected when none of her job applications received a response.
او وقتی هیچ‌کدام از درخواست‌های شغلی‌اش پاسخی دریافت نکرد، احساس دلشکستگی کرد.
miniContext: Dejected describes a feeling of sadness and disappointment, often after a failure or setback. The dejected students stared at their exam results, wondering where they had gone wrong. Even a dejected mood can improve once someone talks openly about what went wrong.

examples: The novel describes how a cruel tyrant ruled the kingdom for thirty years.
این رمان شرح می‌دهد که چگونه یک ستمگر بی‌رحم سی سال بر آن پادشاهی حکومت کرد.
Citizens finally rose up against the tyrant who had silenced all opposition.
سرانجام شهروندان در برابر آن ستمگری که تمام مخالفان را خاموش کرده بود، قیام کردند.
Some employees jokingly call their strict boss a tyrant because of his harsh rules.
برخی کارمندان به‌شوخی رئیس سخت‌گیرشان را به‌خاطر قوانین سختش ستمگر می‌خوانند.
miniContext: A tyrant is a ruler or leader who uses power cruelly and unfairly, often crushing any disagreement. Throughout history, tyrants have been overthrown once enough people united against them. The play portrays the king as a tyrant whose own fear ultimately leads to his downfall.

examples: The sudden storm began to drench everyone standing at the bus stop.
طوفان ناگهانی شروع کرد همه کسانی را که در ایستگاه اتوبوس ایستاده بودند، کاملاً خیس کند.
He forgot his umbrella, and the rain managed to drench his shirt within minutes.
او چترش را فراموش کرد و باران ظرف چند دقیقه پیراهنش را کاملاً خیس کرد.
Farmers drench the fields with water before planting the new seeds.
کشاورزان پیش از کاشت دانه‌های جدید، زمین‌ها را کاملاً با آب خیس می‌کنند.
miniContext: To drench something means to make it completely wet, usually with a large amount of water. A burst pipe can drench an entire apartment within a few minutes if nobody notices in time. After the water balloon fight, every child at the party was drenched from head to toe.

examples: The old table will wobble unless you tighten the loose screw underneath.
میز قدیمی تلوتلو می‌خورد مگر اینکه پیچ شل زیر آن را سفت کنی.
Toddlers often wobble as they take their very first steps.
کودکان نوپا معمولاً وقتی اولین قدم‌هایشان را برمی‌دارند، تلوتلو می‌خورند.
The bicycle began to wobble dangerously when one of its wheels went flat.
دوچرخه وقتی یکی از چرخ‌هایش پنچر شد، به‌طور خطرناکی شروع کرد به تلوتلو خوردن.
miniContext: To wobble means to move unsteadily from side to side, as if about to lose balance. A newly hatched chick will wobble on its thin legs for the first day or two of life. If a ladder starts to wobble while you are climbing it, stop immediately and check its footing.

examples: The dog was so obedient that it sat down the moment its owner gave the command.
آن سگ آن‌قدر مطیع بود که به‌محض فرمان صاحبش نشست.
Teachers often praise students who are obedient and complete their homework on time.
معلمان معمولاً دانش‌آموزانی را که مطیع هستند و تکالیفشان را به‌موقع انجام می‌دهند، تحسین می‌کنند.
In the story, the obedient servant never questioned his master's orders.
در داستان، آن خدمتکار مطیع هرگز دستورات ارباب خود را زیر سؤال نبرد.
miniContext: Obedient describes someone who willingly follows rules, instructions, or authority without resistance. A well-trained guide dog must be obedient enough to ignore distractions while working. Parents often struggle to balance raising children who are obedient with teaching them to think independently.
